mapper.select: SELECT id,buyer_id,vendor_id,delivery_mode,status,meetup_code,procurement_city FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_orders SET meetup_code=#{code},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND meetup_code IS NULL

UPDATE t_orders SET meetup_confirmed_json=JSON_OBJECT('buyer_id',#{buyer},'confirmed_at',DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s'),'lat',#{lat},'lng',#{lng},'city',#{city}),shipped_at=COALESCE(shipped_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)),ship_risk_flags=CASE WHEN #{cityGap} THEN JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(COALESCE(ship_risk_flags,JSON_ARRAY()),'$', 'meetup_city_gap') ELSE ship_risk_flags END WHERE id=#{id}
